playback.title: Playback
playback.gaplessHint: Skip crossfade between consecutive tracks from the same album — ideal for live and continuous albums.
playback.normalizeHint: Match loudness across all tracks (−14 LUFS, measured in the background after download).
playback.simpleModeHint: Disables Web Audio. Turn on if playback stops when the screen locks (common on iPhone). Applies to this device only and reloads the page.
playback.simpleModeHintIos: Disables Web Audio. Turn on if playback stops when the screen locks (common on iPhone). On iPhone, crossfade is unavailable in this mode. Applies to this device only and reloads the page.

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.accentSongHint: Taken from the cover of the song playing, changes with every song.
appearance.accentDefaultHint: Indigo (default). Now Playing still follows the cover colour.
appearance.visualizerHint: Now Playing and lyrics backgrounds pulse with the bass: the louder the music, the more the colour spreads; quiet parts stay calm.
appearance.visualizerSimple: Turn off Simple mode (under Playback) so the sound can be read.
appearance.uiScaleHint: Scale text and spacing up or down on this device.

autoDl.title: Auto-download
autoDl.hint: Every 6 hours, reviews your listening habits and pre-downloads up to 8 tracks from your favorite and similar artists.
autoDl.evictionNote: When your library exceeds the storage limit set by your admin, RiiMusic automatically removes the tracks you're least likely to play. Liked songs, playlist tracks, songs added in the last 3 days, and songs played in the last 14 days are never removed.

lastRunEvicted.one: Last run {ago}: {msg}, removed {n} rarely played song.
lastRunEvicted.other: Last run {ago}: {msg}, removed {n} rarely played songs.

autoDl.startedToast: Reviewing listening habits and picking tracks to download

account.pwChanged: Password changed. Other devices have been signed out.
account.storageNote: Limit set by your admin. Tracks already on the server still count toward your library.
account.setPwHint: You currently sign in with email codes. Set a password to sign in faster.
account.forgotPwHint: Forgot your password? Sign out and choose “Forgot password?” to get a code by email.
account.privacyNote: Server admins can view your listening habits (top tracks, listening time) for management and recommendations.

data.title: Data
data.clearHistoryHint: Clears plays, stats, and “show less” feedback. Keeps your music, playlists, and lyrics.
data.clearAllHint: Deletes this account's library, playlists, likes, history, and download queue. Keeps your account and settings. Other users are unaffected.
data.confirmAllDesc: Your library, playlists, likes, and history will be permanently deleted. Any in-progress downloads will also be canceled.
data.confirmHistoryDesc: Your stats, Continue listening, and recommendation data will be reset.

offline.title: Offline listening
offline.enableHint: Keep the app, your library and songs you play on this device to listen without a connection. A song's ⋯ menu gets “Save offline”.
offline.autoCacheHint: Songs played for more than 20 seconds are kept on the device.
offline.retentionHint: Since they were last played. “Save offline” songs stay until you remove them.
offline.pinHint: Use “Save offline” in a song's ⋯ menu to keep it for good. “Download file” saves the audio file to your Downloads.
